latest.author: Byteup
latest.text: Is it possible to update the app so Elf Arsenal isn't a requirement for running it? I don't believe it's been updated in a really long time but in addition to that I know it never works for my 12.70 console. It always freezes the console with KP and I'm not the only one, there are hundreds of people I've witnessed on Discord alone having issues with elf arsenal causing KP on their consoles and they never ran it again neither have I.
